2121612989220401599.zh_summary: 這不可能是更風景如畫的一天。恭喜 $RKLB！

2121612923873505663.en_summary: $CCJ uranium play. The uranium miner at the front of the nuclear second phase. If reactors get built, they need fuel, and the fuel cycle starts here. It is the simplest way to own the nuclear buildout without betting on a single reactor design.
2121612923873505663.zh_summary: $CCJ 鈾礦玩法。核電第二階段前端的鈾礦商。如果反應堆被建造，它們需要燃料，燃料循環從這裡開始。這是擁有核電建設而不押注單一反應堆設計的最簡單方式。

2121612752611381703.en_summary: $OKLO buy for 2028-2029. Advanced nuclear for the data-center era: small reactors designed to sit near demand. Its first powerhouse is targeted for commissioning in 2028-2029, with $3.13B of liquidity to get there. The honest caveat is the timeline — nothing is generating revenue yet, and the value is in the first plant working.
2121612752611381703.zh_summary: $OKLO 買入用於2028-2029。數據中心時代的先進核電：設計為靠近需求的小型反應堆。其首個發電廠目標2028-2029年投運，有31.3億美元流動性到達那裡。誠實的警告是時間線——目前沒有產生收入，價值在於首個工廠運作。

2121612557618221164.en_summary: $GEV long term fundamentals. The equipment behind the power: gas turbines, grid gear and services for the buildout of generation and transmission. Every data-center power deal eventually becomes an equipment order, and $GEV is on the receiving end of that chain. The case is a decade of grid investment, not a single cycle.
2121612557618221164.zh_summary: $GEV 長期基本面。電力背後的設備：燃氣輪機、電網設備和服務，用於發電和輸電的建設。每個數據中心電力交易最終成為設備訂單，$GEV處於該鏈的接收端。理由是十年的電網投資，而非單一週期。

2121612545295610171.en_summary: JPMorgan now projects hyperscaler CapEx will surpass $2T by 2028: $AMZN ~$470B, $GOOGL ~$470B, $SPCX ~$370B, $MSFT ~$330B, $META ~$290B, $ORCL ~$100B. While rate of growth may take a breather even a “slower” year in 2028 is expected to add another $321B in spending. So that’s still an enormous amount of capital flowing into AI compute, networking, memory and power infrastructure with next generation of AI systems still ahead of us.
2121612545295610171.zh_summary: JPMorgan現在預測超大規模雲端CapEx到2028年將超過2萬億美元：$AMZN 約4700億，$GOOGL 約4700億，$SPCX 約3700億，$MSFT 約3300億，$META 約2900億，$ORCL 約1000億。雖然增長率可能喘息，即使2028年“較慢”的一年預計仍會增加另外3210億美元支出。所以仍有大量資本流入AI計算、網絡、記憶體和電力基礎設施，下一代AI系統仍在前方。
